column1: # Lamakan confrontation: Ash Jenna's origin, her offer, and Isaac's response.

column3: You came back.\nI wasn't sure you would.{end_wait}
You spoke to us\nin the desert.\nWho are you?{end_wait}
You kept going.\nYou deserve to know\nwhat I am.{end_wait}
You're not Jenna.\nTell us who you are.{end_wait}

I am Jenna. Not yours.
In my world, the Wise One
let everything burn.{page_break}I lived through it.
I won't watch it
happen again.{end_wait}
What do you want\nfrom us? From Isaac?{end_wait}

The beacons brought
my world to ruin.{page_break}I believe he'll do
the same to yours.
Help me stop him.{end_wait}
She believes it, Isaac.\nBut there's something\nshe isn't telling us.{end_wait}
If that's true, we\nneed to understand why.\nNot just strike back.{end_wait}
You stayed to help\nthose miners. You could\nhave left them.{end_wait}
Take her offer?{end_now}
I'll hear you out.\nBut I won't follow\nyou blindly.{end_wait}
Then watch the next\nbeacon. You'll see\nwhat I mean.{end_wait}
Isaac, are you sure?\nWe still know so little.{end_wait}
I'll be waiting at\nthe next lighthouse.\nDon't lose your nerve.{end_wait}
No. We won't gamble\non a story we can't\nverify.{end_wait}
Then find your own\nanswers. The Wise One\nwon't wait for you.{end_wait}
We should go, Isaac.\nKalay is still ahead.{end_wait}
We can doubt her and\nstill take her warning\nseriously.{end_wait}

Your Jenna, Kraden,
and Felix are still
with Menardi.{page_break}The Wise One knows
you're moving. Get
to Kalay.{end_wait}
